news.headline: Susquehanna entities (QURE) disclose 3.34M-share, 4.8% position in uniQure
RTW Investments (QURE) discloses 3.94M-share beneficial stake in uniQure N.V.
Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, Sees 'Clear Path to Approval' for AMT-130
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded uniQure to Outperform with a $65 price target, arguing the market underestimates AMT-130's approval odds, while Wells Fargo, Leerink and RBC also raised targets (to $75, $70 and $65 respectively) following the Q2 print; Barclays trimmed its target to $60 but kept a Buy rating.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported $810.3 million in cash and investments (runway into 2030) after its June equity raise and confirmed it remains on track to submit the AMT-130 BLA in Q3 2026, alongside encouraging early data updates from its Fabry disease (AMT-191) and epilepsy (AMT-260) gene-therapy programs.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Closing of Upsized Public Offering and Full Exercise by Underwriters of Option to Purchase Additional Shares
news.summary: uniQure closed an upsized public offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50 each, raising roughly $259 million in gross proceeds to fund AMT-130 commercialization readiness, a confirmatory study, and other pipeline programs.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Preliminary Data on the First Cohort in the Phase I/IIa Clinical Trial of AMT-260 in Refractory Mesial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
news.summary: In the low-dose cohort of the AMT-260 epilepsy trial, three of six patients saw disabling seizures drop 79-100% from baseline at months four to six, with a generally well-tolerated safety profile, as enrollment continues in a higher-dose cohort.

news.headline: uniQure Provides Regulatory Update on AMT-130 for Huntington's Disease
news.summary: Following an FDA Type B meeting, uniQure said the agency agreed the existing 3-year Phase I/II data could serve as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease; shares surged roughly 78% on the news.

catalysts.label: US BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit the Biologics License Application for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease under the FDA's accelerated approval pathway.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA marketing application (MAA) filing
catalysts.detail: Following a successful pre-submission meeting, uniQure plans to file a UK Marketing Authorisation Application for AMT-130 in the same quarter as the US BLA.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 Phase I/II data
catalysts.detail: Full four-year follow-up data on all 24 patients (12 high-dose, 12 low-dose) from the pivotal Huntington's disease study, to be included in the regulatory package.

catalysts.label: Initiation of AMT-130 confirmatory study
catalysts.detail: Company plans to start the post-marketing confirmatory trial required alongside the accelerated approval pathway once the BLA is submitted.

catalysts.label: Updated AMT-260 epilepsy data
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to present updated Phase I/IIa results, including the higher-dose cohort, for its refractory temporal lobe epilepsy program.

catalysts.label: FDA decision on AMT-130 BLA
catalysts.detail: If the Q3 2026 BLA filing is accepted for standard rolling review, an approval decision could arrive roughly six to twelve months after submission.

pulse: uniQure is riding strong momentum after the FDA agreed in June 2026 that existing 3-year AMT-130 data can support an accelerated-approval BLA for Huntington's disease, a decision that sent shares sharply higher and triggered a wave of analyst upgrades and price-target increases. The company closed a $259 million equity raise in late June, pushing its cash runway into 2030, and remains on track to file both a US BLA and a UK MHRA application in Q3 2026, with confirmatory four-year data due around September and encouraging early readouts also emerging from its Fabry disease and epilepsy gene-therapy programs. Sentiment has turned decisively bullish, though the ultimate regulatory outcome for AMT-130 remains the key swing factor for the stock.
